lines.text: 一 般 现 在 时 的 否定 式 为 don?t/doesn't + 动词 :
0 I drink coffee, but I don’t drink tea.
O Sue drinks tea, but she doesn’t drink coffee.
O You don’t work very hard.
O We don’t watch television very often.
O The weather is usually nice. It doesn’t rain very often.
O Gary and Nicole don’t know many people.
OI don’t like Fred and Fred doesn’t like me. (而 不 用 Fred don’t like)
口 My car doesn’t use much petrol. (而 不 用 My car don’t use)
D Sometimes he is late, but it doesn’t happen very often.
85) don’t/doesn’t + Hi BF (don't like / doesn’t speak / doesn’t do 等 ,而 不 用 其 他 形式 )
0 I don’t like washing the car. I don’t do it very often.
O Sarah speaks Spanish, but she doesn’t speak Italian. (而 不 用 doesn’t speaks)
0 Bill doesn’t do his job very well. (而 不 用 Bill doesn’t his job)
O Paula doesn’t usually have breakfast. (而 不 用 doesn’t ... has)
1 do/work/like 等 (一般 现 在 时 ) = Unit 5 Do you... ? (一 般 现在 时 的 疑问 式 ) — Unit 7
